concept: AI matches a described personal trait/goal to a real historical samurai sword-guard (tsuba) motif and its symbolism, with a gallery of real design schools (Higo, Owari, Umetada, etc).

AI matches a described worry/situation to one of the paired shrine guardian lion-dog (koma-inu) statues and the real meaning of their open/closed mouths (a-un), with a regional-style reference gallery.
AI matches a described occasion/gift to a real traditional Japanese braided-cord (kumihimo) pattern and color meaning, with step-by-step braid-structure explanations and Iga/Kyo regional styles.

AI matches a described family situation (space, budget, tradition level) to the right tier of Hina Matsuri doll set (from single-pair to full seven-tier), explaining the real meaning of each tier's figures.
